#
# (H) /etc/config/wireless — REFERENCE TEMPLATE.
#
# Do NOT blindly copy this over /etc/config/wireless: the `option path` value is
# unit-specific and is generated by OpenWrt on first boot. The active config is
# applied by files/etc/uci-defaults/99-custom-defaults, which edits the
# auto-detected radio0/radio1 in place (path-safe). This file is for reference and
# manual tuning only. Get YOUR real path with:  uci show wireless
#
# radio0 = 2.4 GHz (mt7915 band0) ; radio1 = 5 GHz (mt7915 band1)
#
# txpower: see docs/txpower-explained.md. 30 dBm is NOT a realistic/legal per-band
# value for this hardware. Leave txpower UNSET so the driver applies the legal max
# from your country + the device calibration. Setting a number only ever LOWERS it.
#

config wifi-device 'radio0'
	option type 'mac80211'
	option path 'PLACEHOLDER-run: uci show wireless'   # e.g. 1e140000.pcie/...
	option band '2g'
	option channel 'auto'        # pick a clean one from your survey (1/6/11)
	option htmode 'HT20'         # stability first; HT40 only if survey is clean
	option country '00'          # <-- set YOUR ISO code (US, DE, GB, PK, ...)
	option cell_density '0'
	# option txpower  -> intentionally omitted (let driver use legal max)

config wifi-iface 'default_radio0'
	option device 'radio0'
	option network 'lan'
	option mode 'ap'
	option ssid 'CR6606-24G'
	option encryption 'sae-mixed'   # WPA2/WPA3 mixed
	option key 'CHANGE_ME_STRONG_PASSWORD'
	option disabled '0'

config wifi-device 'radio1'
	option type 'mac80211'
	option path 'PLACEHOLDER-run: uci show wireless'
	option band '5g'
	option channel 'auto'        # 36/40/44/48 (UNII-1) are universally legal & no-DFS
	option htmode 'HE80'         # AX 80 MHz; drop to HE40/HE20 if instability seen
	option country '00'
	option cell_density '0'
	# option txpower  -> omitted on purpose

config wifi-iface 'default_radio1'
	option device 'radio1'
	option network 'lan'
	option mode 'ap'
	option ssid 'CR6606-5G'
	option encryption 'sae-mixed'
	option key 'CHANGE_ME_STRONG_PASSWORD'
	option disabled '0'
